objective: Determine whether bounded, source-witnessed (P1,P2)->P3 relation templates can be induced from the previously consumed full historical TRAIN image, as opposed to NKR-09 synthetic overlay-only template mining. Never interpret correlations as causality.

scope.previous_work: WSP-105/116 already assessed real-graph two-hop retrieval/knowledge coverage; WSP-110/111 synthetic operator induction; FKP-18 conditional temporal representation. This is only historical original-triple rule-support mining, no duplicate heldout score, no further model changes.
scope.input: NKR05 previously consumed 21,343,681 TRAIN triples; source noncanonical historical Wikidata5M variant, archive CC0-structured data; read only

frozen_selection.anchor_formula: for k in [0,K), row_index=floor(k*(N-1)/(K-1)), K=min(32768,N); N=1 index0
frozen_selection.sampling_bias: lexicographic-strided source rows, not unbiased representative sampling; top eight outgoing source edges per subject can censor context
frozen_selection.deterministic: row-index iteration and sorted triple order; count distinct subjects; rank descending count then ascending relation ID triple

controls: fixture independently enumerated exhaustive reference on an in-memory sorted graph
same fixture with one target leg removed; zero unsupported candidates
duplicate edges and anchor subjects must not increase support
tampered source receipt denied; no historical read in tests
no stable source IDs treated as semantic truth

classify.engineering_pass: exact specified sample, fixed budgets, sorted deterministic positive witness lists, no source or accepted-state mutation, fixture/exact root/G29 dual OS PASS
classify.bounded_positive: at least one template has >=6 distinct supporting historical TRAIN subjects; engineering evidence only
classify.bounded_negative: zero templates at support >=6; stop; do not tune sampling after inspecting scan results
classify.invalid: source pin mismatch, overflow, noncanonical facts, unbounded scan, duplicate inflation, failed regression, unauthorized read
classify.scientific_pass: always false for this experiment; no action/consequence, independent withheld new causal laws or fully trained matched conventional model

stop: historical data unavailable or missing previous image custody
any valid/test or protected source request
